content_blocks.label: clause_1._Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means all information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party that is marked as confidential, or that would reasonably be understood to be confidential given the context of its disclosure.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Obligations
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall keep all Confidential Information strictly confidential and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Exceptions
content_blocks.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing, the obligations set forth in Section 2.1 hereof shall not apply to information that is publicly known, or becomes publicly known through no fault of the Receiving Party.
